title: Affine-spectrum adjunction for arbitrary locally ringed spaces
statement: Let $Z$ be a locally ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] and $R$ a commutative ring. Sending a morphism of locally ringed spaces $f:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] to the ring homomorphism $R\cong\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}R,\mathcal O)\xrightarrow{f^\sharp}\Gamma(Z,\mathcal O_Z)$ is a bijection. This bijection is natural in $Z$ and $R$. In particular the identity of $\Gamma(Z,\mathcal O_Z)$ determines a unique morphism $Z\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(Z,\mathcal O_Z)$.
